summary_en: This Phase 1/2 study tests CRB-701, an antibody-drug conjugate that targets nectin-4, in adults with advanced solid tumors that express nectin-4. CRB-701 is given as an intravenous infusion over 30 minutes, and some arms also receive an anti-PD-1 infusion; how many times and how often is not stated. The main goal is to find a safe and effective dose of CRB-701, and the record does not state a specific primary outcome measure.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase 1/2 evalúa CRB-701, un conjugado anticuerpo-fármaco que se dirige a nectin-4, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados que expresan nectin-4. CRB-701 se administra como infusión intravenosa durante 30 minutos, y algunos grupos también reciben una infusión de anti-PD-1; no se indica cuántas veces ni con qué frecuencia. El objetivo principal es encontrar una dosis segura y eficaz de CRB-701, y el registro no indica una medida de resultado principal específica.
who_for: Confirmed diagnosis of select advanced or metastatic solid tumors that express nectin-4
Disease has progressed after all appropriate lines of therapy, or no other standard therapy with proven clinical benefit exists
Head and neck squamous cell carcinoma participants may enroll as first-line therapy in Part C
not_for: History of solid tumors other than the diseases under study
Cardiovascular events or conditions in the previous 6 months, or neuropathy of grade 2 or higher before study
HbA1c of 8% or higher, uncontrolled diabetes, or known diabetic neuropathy
Active eye disease at baseline, severe chronic liver disease or cirrhosis, or interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis within 6 months
